messages:
Alex: noticing a bunch of 504s from hosted inference for tenant acme-inc around 14:01 UTC. Customers reported timeouts, support ticket #9842 opened. p99 ~11s on gateway. guess: request queue saturation + tail-latency from continuous batcher.
Maria: looking at dashboards now — queue_depth for hostpool-us-east-1-A jumped to 1200 (limit 1024) at 14:02. continuous_batcher.backlog_count increased ~4x. kvcache.miss_rate doubled.
Kevin: confirmed logs show repeated request_enqueue_rejects then long dequeue delays. gateway logs: 504s with upstream timeout after 10s. sample ingress trace id: trace-0a1b2c.
support-bot: Alert: hosted-gateway 504-rate > 5% for tenant acme-inc (14:02 - 14:08).
Jo: quick repro I ran locally with a replay of tenant traffic — one long-running request pattern (many long sequences) hits batcher and causes other tiny requests to wait, building tail backlog. continuous batching queues up large KV contexts so dispatch is slow.
Alex: can we apply an immediate mitigation? options: drop very long requests from shared pool, route tenant to dedicated soft-pool, reduce batch_max_size or lower max_queue_depth.
Maria: suggested temp fixes — 1) set max_queue_depth per hostpool to 800, 2) enable prefix_kvcache for longseqs (if available) or mark them cold-path, 3) apply per-tenant ingress rate-limiter to smooth spikes.
Kevin: I'll push a targeted rate-limit for acme-inc (from 500 rps to 200 rps) and change batcher config: batch_max_tokens 4096 -> 2048 and batch_max_delay 20ms -> 10ms.
Alex: applied rate-limit and lowered batch_max_tokens on hostpool-us-east-1-A at 14:12 UTC. rolling restart not required for the config change.
ops-bot: Config change deployed to hostpool-us-east-1-A at 14:12:34 by Kevin.
Maria: after changes p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 300ms and p99 from 11s -> 1.3s within ~90s. queue_depth now stabilizing ~320. KV miss rate down slightly.
Jo: logs snippets: ```
[14:02:01] enqueue request id=abcd123 len=12000 tenant=acme-inc -> queued
[14:02:03] enqueue request id=efgh456 len=28 tenant=acme-inc -> queued behind long seq
[14:12:45] dequeue id=efgh456 took=0.9s
[14:12:46] dequeue id=abcd123 took=9.6s
```
Kevin: customer facing update sent: "We've applied throttling and batching changes to mitigate tail timeouts. Please let us know if you still see errors." Ticket #9842 updated.
Alex: followup actions: (a) postmortem draft, (b) runbook update to add automatic detection of long-seq tailbacks, (c) consider tenant isolation / soft pools for heavy longseq workloads.
Maria: adding metrics to detect continuous_batcher.backlog_count > X && queue_depth > Y to auto-fire a playbook.
Jo: also recommend adding a safeguard to not let a single request expand batch window beyond threshold — e.g., cap batch size contribution per-request.
Kevin: I'll file a Jira (INF-3421) for runbook and safeguards.
ops-bot: Monitoring alert resolved at 14:15:12 UTC.
Alex: great work everyone — p99 stable at ~1.2s now. closing incident chat but will follow up in postmortem. :thumbsup:
